name: Sesame Seeds
siboNotes: Sesame seeds are naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated on SIBO diets. Their healthy fats may help with nutrient absorption.
preparationTips: Toast lightly to enhance nutty flavor and digestibility
Store in airtight container to prevent rancidity
Can be ground into tahini paste for easier digestion
Soak briefly before use to improve digestibility
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of calcium and magnesium
